g.text: First 8 slots of a separate 64-episode diagnostic; all traces end at 20 s. Triangles: initial samples; squares: final samples; green disks: 0.1 m goal regions.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Dashed lines: goal radius 0.1 m, linear threshold 0.1 m/s, and angular threshold 0.1 rad/s. Settling requires both speed thresholds continuously for 0.5 s.

g.text: Trace sampling: every 5 control steps (0.1 s). Root paths alone do not certify body clearance. These 8 traces do not estimate the formal 1,000-episode rates.
